title: UN Commission findings on attacks against four Gaza hospitals
summary: The Commission assessed Israeli attacks on Nasr, Shifa, Awdah and Turkish-Palestinian Friendship hospitals.
claim: The Commission found that Israeli security forces failed to adhere to precaution, distinction and proportionality in attacks on four Gaza hospitals, constituting war crimes of wilful killing and attacks against protected objects.
legal_characterization: War-crime finding by a UN commission of inquiry under its evidentiary standard; not a judicial judgment or conviction.
source_organization: United Nations Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
source_title: Report of the Independent International Commission of Inquiry on the Occupied Palestinian Territory, including East Jerusalem, and Israel
verification_notes: Verified against paragraphs 91-92 of A/79/232. Unlike the earlier A/HRC/56/26 health-system record, this later report expressly makes hospital-specific legal findings. The record preserves the Commission's status and does not convert the finding into a court judgment.
